findings.issue: Independent check of journal declarations and ethics supports conditional AI-assisted text, code, data and analysis, with substantial human intellectual contribution and disclosure.
findings.resolution: Retain compatible with stated restrictions; journal fee schedule confirms no author charges and identifies Warsaw publisher. Geographic author eligibility remains not stated.

notes: Reviewed all nine baseline and discovery candidates against all three helper files. Journal-specific Sage instructions explicitly state no submission or publication fee; optional OA is separate. Seven instructions affirm worldwide submissions; International Studies instructions lack the shared policy passage and its society evidence is less direct.

VIZJA journal policy explicitly covers generative text, code, data and analysis and disclosure placement; no evidence supports a country restriction. Its official author fees page https://alp-journal.com/index.php/journal/author-fees-and-charges corroborates zero submission, publication, page and colour charges.
Sage publisher policy https://www.sagepub.com/journals/publication-ethics-policies/artificial-intelligence-policy lists restricted prompt generation and thematic analysis; all eight remain excluded.

Official 2025 JCR figures and 2024 acceptance figures for three PSA titles are included. Other six metrics remain empty; the source does not identify acceptance denominators. Source report is marked draft.
